phase_name: Production Observability, Metrics, Tracing & Container Operations

verdict.structured_logging: PROVEN (JSON formatted with contextvars for request_id, workflow_id, tenant_id)
verdict.secret_redaction: PROVEN (Recursive masking of JWTs, API keys, credentials, tokens, passwords)
verdict.correlation_ids: PROVEN (Safe extraction, cryptographic generation, and response header reflection)
verdict.prometheus_metrics: PROVEN (/metrics exporter with strict low-cardinality label controls)
verdict.graceful_shutdown: PROVEN (Lifespan manager, task tracking, and bounded draining)
verdict.production_config_hardening: PROVEN (Fail-closed validation on default secrets, wildcard CORS, persistence)
verdict.docker_container_contract: PROVEN (Multi-stage Dockerfile with non-root appuser and HEALTHCHECK)
verdict.docker_runtime_integration: UNVERIFIED (Docker binary installed, daemon inactive in test environment)

breakdown.persistence_and_state_recovery: CONDITIONALLY VERIFIED (Durable OCC + recovery proven; Firestore emulator unexercised)
breakdown.api_security_auth_rbac: PROVEN (JWT, RBAC, Tenant Isolation, Approver Stamping verified)
breakdown.gemini_runtime_resilience: PROVEN (Global limiter, exponential backoff, circuit breaker, state recovery verified)
breakdown.observability_metrics_ops: PROVEN (JSON logging, redaction, Prometheus metrics, health/ready, graceful shutdown)
breakdown.container_and_orchestration: CONDITIONALLY VERIFIED (Dockerfile contract proven; Docker daemon inactive in local sandbox)

remaining_production_blockers: External Firestore emulator/cloud database live integration testing
Docker runtime image execution and SIGTERM verification inside a live Docker daemon
